using FluentValidation;
using FluentValidation.TestHelper;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using eShop.Ordering.API.Application.Validations;
using eShop.Ordering.API.Application.Commands;

namespace eShop.Ordering.API.Application.Tests.Validations;

public class ShipOrderCommandValidatorTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<ShipOrderCommandValidator>> _loggerMock;
    private readonly ShipOrderCommandValidator _validator;

    public ShipOrderCommandValidatorTests()
    {
        _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<ShipOrderCommandValidator>>();
        _validator = new ShipOrderCommandValidator(_loggerMock.Object);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_WhenTraceLoggingEnabled_CallsLogTrace()
    {
        // Arrange
        _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(true);

        // Act
        var unused = new ShipOrderCommandValidator(_loggerMock.Object);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(
            l => l.LogTrace(
                It.Is<string>(msg => msg == "INSTANCE CREATED - {ClassName}"),
                It.Is<object[]>(args => args.Length == 1 && args[0].ToString() == "ShipOrderCommandValidator")),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_WhenTraceLoggingDisabled_DoesNotCallLogTrace()
    {
        // Arrange
        _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(LogLevel.Trace)).Returns(false);

        // Act
        var unused = new ShipOrderCommandValidator(_loggerMock.Object);

        // Assert
        _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogTrace(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Validate_WhenOrderNumberEmpty_ReturnsValidationError()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = new ShipOrderCommand(0);

        // Act
        var result = _validator.TestValidate(command);

        // Assert
        result.ShouldHaveValidationErrorFor(order => order.OrderNumber)
              .WithErrorMessage("No orderId found");
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Validate_WhenOrderNumberValid_NoValidationErrors()
    {
        // Arrange
        var command = new ShipOrderCommand(123);

        // Act
        var result = _validator.TestValidate(command);

        // Assert
        result.ShouldNotHaveValidationErrorFor(order => order.OrderNumber);
    }
}
